newsitem.title: UK: European Press Holdings appoints Andrew Neil.
newsitem.headline: European Press Holdings appoints Andrew Neil.

text.p: Andrew Neil, the gritty former editor of Britain's Sunday Times, was named editor-in-chief on Monday of European Press Holdings, owner of The European and three Scottish newspapers.
The company said it hoped the appointment of Scottish-born Neil would help boost circulation of its four titles, which also include The Scotsman, Scotland on Sunday and the Edinburgh Evening News.
"His knowledge and understanding of our market will give added support and leadership to our four talented editors and their editorial teams," said the group's chief executive, Bert Hardy.
Neil was editor of the Sunday Times from 1983 until 1994, when he moved to the United States to present a show on Rupert Murdoch's Fox Television.
The programme was cancelled, however, and Neil has since worked as a freelance journalist and broadcaster.
